title: Bayesian Spatial Posterior with MAP/HPD and Zonal Mass (Section 3.4 reference implementation)
description: Single-file C++17 reference implementation of Section 3.4 (Bayesian posterior and MAP/HPD estimation) of a dissertation on hybrid Bayesian tactical spatial identification of Wi-Fi signal sources. Grid-based recursive Bayesian inference in the log-domain with log-sum-exp normalization (eq. 3.6-3.9), modality-factorized likelihood (eq. 3.7) combining robust Huber RSSI blocks and an LOS/NLOS FTM/RTT mixture (Section 3.5.6) with availability masks. Produces MAP (eq. 3.11), local modes, HPD region (eq. 3.12), zonal posterior mass (eq. 3.13), an explicit out-of-map state (eq. 3.14), entropy, model evidence and an uncertainty budget. A 'fingerprint twins' demonstration (Section 3.4.10) shows fusion as a normalized product rather than an average of coordinates. No external dependencies; runs as-is on OnlineGDB. Operating points are to_be_validated. Analytical illustration, not empirical data.
